limitations: Exactly two perfectly grounded leaders; symmetric complete bipartite matching-weighted network; \(t>0\) and integer \(n\ge3\). The first/second-power threshold mismatch is proved for all sufficiently large n and at an exact n=3 witness, not asserted for every n. Other weight structures, noisy leaders and higher powers are not covered; no independent validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_integrity: Exact analytic classification with symbolic coefficient certificates and supporting exact finite matrix checks; all-size proof is independent of finite enumeration. The spectral objective is specifically the inverse square of the unnormalized grounded Laplacian.
title: A vanishing cubic boundary layer in inverse-square leader placement on matching-weighted bipartite networks
